decisive_passage: A.1 **Precedence.** This Rider A forms part of the Subcontract. **In the event of any conflict between this Rider A and any other provision of the Subcontract Documents, this Rider A controls.** A.2 **Retention.** **Retention under this Subcontract is five percent (5%).** This rate supersedes and replaces the ten percent (10%) retention rate stated in Paragraph 5.1 of the Subcontract.
